finding: A running AudioContext and a started, destination-connected source are runtime evidence, not proof that a person heard sound. Human audibility requires a separate bounded observation, and disagreement between machine signal evidence and human report must remain visible as contradiction.
privacy: Stores only coarse booleans and state labels; no audio samples, microphone input, private text, selectors, URLs, or user identifiers.
falsification_route: Run the classifier against a physical iPhone Safari harness. Revise if a machine-only state can validly establish bounded human audibility, or if contradictory human and signal observations are collapsed into a positive claim.
limits: Deterministic Node tests do not establish iPhone Safari behavior.
A fulfilled resume promise does not prove audible hardware output.
Human confirmation is bounded to the tested device, route, volume state, and session.
